pr_title: dissect: support to unmount image without root partition
pr_comments: Don't we have to unmount the tmpfs as well? Also @poettering was thinking about implementing a policy for systemd-dissect to tell it what partitions to mount so any number of partitions from a disk image could be mounted and ideally --umount would be able to deal with all of them.
Ah, nice catch. Will fix later. Thanks.
I made my own attempt to fix this in #25572, PTAL!
@DaanDeMeyer and @poettering Thank you for your review. Updated. PTAL!

issue_context.title: systemd-dissect --umount does not handle usr only images mounted with systemd-dissect --mount

### Used distribution

### Linux kernel version used

### CPU architectures issue was seen on

x86_64

### Component

other

### Expected behaviour you didn't see

_No response_

```
➜  mkosi git:(repart) ✗ sudo systemd-dissect mkosi.output/fedora~37/image.raw -M abc

efi/  usr/
➜  mkosi git:(repart) ✗ sudo ../systemd/build/systemd-dissect -U abc
```
